nodes.label: ADR-007: Ephemeral Session-Scoped Companion State Layer
nodes.rationale: Rejected writing every focus shift to GENESIS (write amplification, database bloat, slower semantic recall) and rejected stateless per-turn prompting (contextually blind between turns, forces massive event logs into reasoning engines). Status: Proposed.

nodes.label: Ephemeral Session-Scoped State
nodes.rationale: Memory stores what the user has achieved; State tracks what they are doing right now. The layer initializes at session start, evolves in memory, and expires at session end — only a consolidated summary is committed via Reflection. Everything in it is volatile and lost on termination unless summarized.
